duplication_audit.novel_axis: bounded empirical characteristic-function coordinates of standardized multiscale historical increments
duplication_audit.distinction: v42 estimates state-conditional low-order increment moments. v43 ignores state bins and embeds each unconditional increment distribution by fixed complex characteristic-function coordinates. These distribution frequencies are not temporal Fourier frequencies, cross-channel entropy, bispectrum, tail-hit correlation, or sample entropy.

encoder.input: historical hs, tp, hmax, and wind-speed paths at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
encoder.increment_standardization: per lag/channel median and IQR, zero-IQR fallback 1

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Feuerverger and Mureika, The Empirical Characteristic Function and Its Applications, Annals of Statistics 5, 88-97 (1977)
primary_sources.use: empirical characteristic-function mechanism only; not performance evidence
